scope_note: County incremental sources only. Statewide NJGIN/MOD-IV, NJ DCA construction, FEMA flood, NJDEP environmental, ACS/Census geography, and six-hub NJ state intelligence are referenced, not reacquired. No shared four-county manifest is edited here.

sources.source_name: Middlesex County ArcGIS Server / Open Data Portal
sources.refresh_method: Do not reverse-engineer the Web Adaptor. Use AGOL hosted services instead.
sources.terms_notes: Third-party notes say free registration may be required. Portal returned HTTP 500; REST root returned a login/Web Adaptor page.
sources.redistribution_notes: Do not claim an undocumented anonymous API.
sources.recommended_next_action: Use hosted AGOL zoning and incentives services. Optional later: register a free account if terms allow documented downloads.

sources.refresh_method: ArcGIS REST query with resultOffset pagination; maxRecordCount 2000; returnGeometry=false for attribute extracts.
sources.terms_notes: Planning compilation of municipal zoning. Confirm with the municipality. Not a legal survey.
sources.redistribution_notes: Do not ingest geometries into git. Municipal zoning boards remain authoritative.
sources.recommended_next_action: Keep as the county zoning overlay for the four-county spine.

sources.refresh_method: ArcGIS REST query per layer. Do not build a CRE database.
sources.terms_notes: Middlesex County Office of Planning GIS support contact on layer metadata.
sources.redistribution_notes: Redevelopment/brownfield/UEZ polygons are not projects, permits, or contractor findings.
sources.recommended_next_action: Use layer inventory for Investor/Contractor county context.

sources.source_name: NJGIN Parcels and MOD-IV Composite (Middlesex filter)
sources.grain: tax parcel polygon + selected MOD-IV attributes
sources.refresh_method: ArcGIS REST query where=COUNTY='MIDDLESEX' with pagination.
sources.terms_notes: OWNER_NAME redacted per Daniel's Law. Polygons are not legal boundaries.
sources.redistribution_notes: Statewide service; do not duplicate into git.
sources.recommended_next_action: Reuse statewide NJGIN. Count verified: 243019 Middlesex features.

sources.source_name: Middlesex County Clerk SearchNG land records
sources.refresh_method: Browser or desktop SearchNG client. Hours 5am-11pm. No documented API.
sources.terms_notes: Clerk presents information as a public service with no warranty. User is responsible for assessing accuracy. Clerk cannot perform title searches.
sources.redistribution_notes: Public land record is not a recommendation. Mortgage recording is not a current balance. Construction lien is not contractor wrongdoing. Do not scrape the session portal.
sources.blocker: SearchNG session portal. .NET client / browser search only.
sources.recommended_next_action: See docs/nj-counties/middlesex-land-records-access-assessment.md and the narrow metadata request.

sources.refresh_method: Re-open current listing page. Capture status inventory only.
sources.terms_notes: Public service summary listing. Not an official title record.
sources.redistribution_notes: Scheduled != completed. Adjourned != completed. Redeemed != completed sale. Purchased - 3rd Party is the completed-sale status on this listing. Defendant names not stored.
sources.recommended_next_action: Keep status inventory. Do not productize as a buyer list.

sources.source_name: Middlesex County Office of Inspections / Consumer Affairs
sources.refresh_method: Phone 732-398-2300 or email consumer@co.middlesex.nj.us. No bulk download.
sources.terms_notes: Office searches businesses with a complaint filed in the last 3 years. If CFA violations are found, County Counsel may take the case to municipal court. Complaint is not a violation.
sources.blocker: No public bulk file. Lookup is staff-mediated and limited to 3 years.
sources.recommended_next_action: Send the narrow non-PII request in docs/nj-counties/middlesex-consumer-affairs-request.md. Do not wait.

sources.source_name: Middlesex ADRC / senior centers / congregate meals
sources.refresh_method: Re-read official HTML. Services Locator is zip search only, not a bulk API.
sources.terms_notes: Public county program directory. Resource Directory PDF exists; this ticket does not deep-extract it.
sources.blocker: Official HTML page is bot-restricted (403/Access Denied to automated fetch). Public search snippets plus congregate-site page were used. Remaining municipal senior-center rows should be copied from the same official page.
sources.recommended_next_action: Complete remaining municipal senior-center rows from the official page. Do not PDF-extract the full resource directory.
